终结宇宙：转向特工轨迹Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories
进入可扩展的终端环境into Scalable Terminal Environments

Jie Wu Affiliation: Qwen Team, Alibaba Group    Tsinghua University    Zhenru Zhang Affiliation: Project leader    Beichen Zhang    Xuwu Wang    Yuhui Su    Mouxiang Chen    Peng Wang    Zhihai Wang    Que Shen    Hao Zhou    An Yang    Fei Huang    Yujiu Yang Affiliation: Qwen Team, Alibaba Group    Tsinghua University Affiliation: Corresponding authors    Dayiheng Liu Affiliation: Corresponding authors
摘要Abstract

随着基于终端的代码代理变得越来越普遍，相应的代理轨迹已经大规模积累，而现实的可执行环境仍然稀缺。 然而，环境是代理训练后实际需要的：每个环境都可以重新查询到许多可验证的任务并提供执行反馈，而轨迹是单个冻结的演示。 我们不是从头开始生成环境，而是观察到现有代理轨迹中的工具执行历史公开了它们运行的​​环境的结构和内容，使得从轨迹本身重建这些环境成为可能。 因此，我们介绍As terminal-based code agents become increasingly prevalent, the corresponding agent trajectories have accumulated at scale, while realistic, executable environments remain scarce. However, environments are what agent post-training actually requires: each one can be re-queried into many verifiable tasks and provides the execution feedback, whereas a trajectory is a single frozen demonstration. Rather than generating environments from scratch, we observe that the tool-execution history in the existing agent trajectories exposes the structure and contents of the environments in which they ran, making it possible to reconstruct those environments from the trajectories themselves. Thus, we introduce终端宇宙Terminal-Universe，一个框架，将每个轨迹转变为可重用的环境，并探索它以综合新任务和持续交互。 具体来说，Terminal-Universe 会重放轨迹中记录的文件操作，以恢复代理修改文件之前的每个文件，从而产生部分工作空间；然后，完成代理会提供丢失的文件和依赖项。 在这个恢复的工作空间上，我们既重建了最初的意图任务，又合成了全新的任务。 此外，我们还沿着两个互补的轴：广度和深度来扩展相应环境的任务，以重现真实工程实践的常规模式。 为了广度，我们挖掘相关环境之间的方向依赖关系，并综合跨越多个代码库的跨工作空间查询，就像开发人员在实际开发中经常做的那样。 为了深度，我们将最初的单轮查询扩展到多轮会话，通过用户代理捕获迭代的用户反馈和需求细化。 应用于公开可用的终端代理轨迹，Terminal-Universe 产生, a framework which turns each trajectory into a reusable environment and explores it for synthesizing new tasks and continued interactions. Specifically, Terminal-Universe replays the file operations recorded in a trajectory to restore each file before the agent modified it, yielding a partial workspace; a completion agent then supplies the missing files and dependencies. On this recovered workspace, we both reconstruct the original intent task and synthesize entirely new ones. Besides, we also scale the tasks for the corresponding environment along two complementary axes: breadth and depth, to reproduce a routine pattern of real engineering practice. For breadth, we mine directional dependency relations between related environments and synthesize cross-workspace queries spanning multiple codebases, as developers routinely do in real-world development. For depth, we extend the initial single-turn query into a multi-round session that captures iterative user feedback and requirement refinement via a user agent. Applied to publicly available terminal agent trajectories, Terminal-Universe produces37.337.3k 任务充足的环境。 在此语料库上对 Qwen3.5-27B 进行监督微调，将 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上的单轮性能提高了 11.9 点，将 EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4 上的多轮性能提高了 13.8 点。k task-sufficient environments. Supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-27B on this corpus improves single-round performance on Terminal-Bench 2.1 by 11.9 points and multi-round performance on EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4 by 13.8 points.

1 简介Introduction

随着基于终端的代码代理变得越来越普遍，它们产生的轨迹已经大规模积累，而现实的可执行环境仍然稀缺。 这种差距很重要，因为轨迹和环境并不同样有用。 轨迹是一个单一的、固定的记录：它的质量受到生成它的策略模型的响应的限制，我们无法检查它对代码库所做的更改是否实际上是正确的。 环境没有这些限制，因为相同的任务可以通过更强大的模型再次解决，结果可以通过我们自己的测试进行验证，并且可以在同一个工作空间上提出更困难的任务。 因此，对于训练后，环境是值得扩展的资源。 专家编写的基准测试展示了良好的环境是什么样子的。终端长凳As terminal-based code agents become increasingly prevalent, the trajectories they produce have accumulated at scale, while realistic, executable environments remain scarce. This gap matters because a trajectory and an environment are not equally useful. A trajectory is a single, fixed record: its quality is bounded by the responses of the policy model that produced it, and we cannot check whether the changes it made to the codebase are actually correct. An environment has none of these limits, because the same task can be solved again by a stronger model, the result can be verified by our own tests, and harder tasks can be posed on the same workspace. For post-training, the environment is therefore the resource worth scaling. Expert-authored benchmarks show what a good environment looks like. Terminal-Bench(Merrill et al., 2026)例如，将每个任务与自定义容器、指令和可执行验证器配对。 这种可靠性来自于手动工作，这也限制了可以构建的任务数量，而有效的后期培训需要的环境远远超出手动管理所能提供的环境。 因此，提供真实、可验证的训练规模环境是我们面临的挑战。, for example, pairs every task with a custom container, an instruction, and an executable verifier. This reliability comes from manual effort, which also limits how many tasks can be built, while effective post-training needs far more environments than manual curation can provide. Supplying realistic, verifiable environments at training scale is therefore the challenge we address.

现有工作通过三种方式扩展可执行环境。Existing work scales executable environments in three ways.基于存储库的方法Repository-based methods从真实存储库的 git 历史记录构建任务build tasks from the git history of a real repository(Pan et al., 2024; Jain et al., 2025)。 对于过去修复过的bug，他们使用git将存储库回滚到修复前的状态，形成环境，以原始bug报告为任务，并重用修复后附带的测试来检查解决方案。. For a bug that was fixed in the past, they use git to roll the repository back to the state just before the fix to form the environment, take the original bug report as the task, and reuse the tests that came with the fix to check the solution.扰动方法Perturbation methods获取通过测试的存储库，注入错误，以便某些测试现在失败，然后要求代理修复它take a repository that passes its tests, inject a bug so that some tests now fail, and ask the agent to fix it(Yang et al., 2025; Lin et al., 2026)。 少数存储库可以通过这种方式产生许多任务，但每个任务都是修复任务，并且任务的范围受到源存储库和可以注入的错误类型的限制。. A few repositories can yield many tasks this way, but every task is a repair task, and the range of tasks is limited by the source repositories and the kinds of bugs that can be injected.任务条件合成Task-conditioned synthesis在类别或组合轴的指导下，从头开始生成任务及其环境generates the task and its environment together from scratch, guided by categories or compositional axes(Gandhi et al., 2026; Ivison et al., 2026), 技能分类, skill taxonomies(Hua et al., 2026)，或技能图, or skill graph(Fan et al., 2026)。 这些方法提供了对覆盖范围和任务环境对齐的控制，但环境不与任何实际项目绑定，因此其真实性完全取决于生成器，生成器往往会生成小而整洁的工作空间，而不是真实的代码。. These methods offer control over coverage and task-environment alignment, but the environment is not tied to any real project, so its realism depends entirely on the generator, which tends to produce small and tidy workspaces rather than real code.

在这些路线中，环境构建要么从现有环境开始，要么从头开始耦合到新生成的任务。 作为对其运行环境的观察，轨迹作为一种资源在很大程度上仍未得到充分开发。 轨迹内记录的工具调用已经揭示了其运行环境的内容和结构。 例如，该工具Across these routes, environment construction either starts from an existing environment or is coupled to a newly generated task from scratch. Trajectories, as observations of the environments they ran in, remain largely underexplored as a resource. The tool calls recorded inside a trajectory already reveal the content and structure of the environment it ran in. For instance, the tool阅读Read显示文件内容，以及shows file contents, and写Write和and编辑Edit显示工作区如何变化。 这足以重建原始工作区的可执行副本。 因此，我们建议show how the workspace changed. This is enough to rebuild an executable copy of the original workspace. Therefore, we propose终端宇宙Terminal-Universe (Figure 1），一个框架，将每个轨迹转变为可重用的环境，并探索它以综合新任务和持续交互。), a framework which turns each trajectory into a reusable environment and explores it for synthesizing new tasks and continued interactions.

具体来说，根据轨迹构建环境（Specifically, to construct the environments based on the trajectories (§ 3.1），我们首先重放记录的文件操作，并将每个文件恢复到代理更改之前的状态，阻止代理自己的编辑，以便工作区开始无法解决。 由于重播通常仅产生部分工作空间，因此完成代理会自动提供任务所需的丢失文件和依赖项，而不会泄漏解决方案。 对于相应的任务，我们既重构了原始意图查询，又合成了全新的意图查询。 此外，为了更好地匹配现实世界的软件工程场景，我们还沿着两个互补的轴扩展环境中的任务：广度和深度（), we first replay the recorded file operations and restore each file to its state before the agent changed it, holding back the agent’s own edits so that the workspace starts unsolved. Since replay usually yields only a partial workspace, a completion agent then automatically supplies the missing files and dependencies the task needs, without leaking the solution. For the corresponding tasks, we both reconstruct the original intent queries and synthesize entirely new ones. Besides, to better match real-world software engineering scenarios, we also scale the tasks on the environment along two complementary axes: breadth and depth (§ 3.2). 广度扩展Breadth expansion超越了大多数任务合成所假设的单一存储库设置。 我们识别相关环境之间的依赖关系，并构建跨越多个代码库的跨工作空间任务，这些任务要困难得多，例如，读取参考实现、将功能从一个项目移动到另一个项目或连接两个组件。goes beyond the single-repository setting that most task synthesis assumes. We identify dependency relations between related environments and build cross-workspace tasks that span multiple codebases which are much harder, e.g., reading a reference implementation, moving a feature from one project to another, or connecting two components.深度拓展Depth expansion将单轮任务变成多轮任务。 代理完成初始查询后，用户代理会在工作区发生变化时要求进行基础的后续操作，以新的要求扩展工作区，或者当一轮失败时，根据问题所在要求修复。我们验证每一轮，并将结果作为自然的、用户可见的反馈反馈给代理。 每个新任务都带有一个由容器内的代理编写的验证器，我们只保留测试全部通过的轨迹（turns a single-round task into a multi-round one. After the agent completes an initial query, a user agent asks grounded follow-ups as the workspace changes—extending it with new requirements, or, when a round fails, asking for a fix based on what went wrong. We verify every round, and the outcome is fed back to the agent as natural, user-visible feedback. Every new task comes with a verifier written by an agent inside the container, and we keep only the trajectories whose tests all pass (§ 4).

在公开可用的终端代理轨迹上，该管道产生On publicly available terminal agent trajectories, this pipeline produces37.337.3k 任务充足的环境。 在这些环境中，我们生成新的查询并使用 Qwen3.7-Max 作为教师来为每个任务推出解决方案轨迹。 使用结果数据训练 Qwen3.5-27B 验证了我们方法的有效性：它通过以下方式改进了单轮基准 Terminal-Bench 2.1k task-sufficient environments. Over these environments, we generate new queries and use Qwen3.7-Max as the teacher to roll out a solution trajectory for each task. Training Qwen3.5-27B on the resulting data validates the effectiveness of our method: it improves the single-round benchmark Terminal-Bench 2.1 by11.911.9点和多轮基准 EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4points and the multi-round benchmark EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4 by13.813.8点（points (§ 5）。 广泛的消融证实了每个组件都有贡献，最值得注意的是，在重建环境中重新解决任务的效果远远优于模仿原始轨迹。). Extensive ablations confirm that each component contributes, most notably that re-solving tasks in reconstructed environments far outperforms imitating the raw trajectories.

总而言之，我们做出了以下贡献：To sum up, we make the following contributions:

  • •

    环境重建。Environments reconstruction.我们将记录的代理轨迹重新构建为可重用可执行环境的来源，并通过确定性重放和代理完成来重建每个轨迹，而不需要原始存储库或从头开始构建。We reframe recorded agent trajectories as a source of reusable executable environments, and reconstruct each one through deterministic replay followed by agentic completion—without needing the original repository or building from scratch.

  • •

    重新查询方法。Re-querying methods.我们通过新任务生成来扩展每个重建环境的效用。除了普通的单工作空间和单轮任务之外，我们还通过跨工作空间任务合成来实现广度扩展，并通过多轮用户查询来实现深度扩展。每个任务都与代理编写的验证器配对，并且仅保留通过的轨迹。We scale the utility of each reconstructed environment through new task generation. Besides the vanilla single-workspace and single-turn tasks, we contribute breadth expansion via cross-workspace task synthesis and depth expansion via multi-round user queries. Each task is paired with an agent-authored verifier, and only trajectories that pass are kept.

  • •

    实证验证。Empirical validation.对生成的语料库进行微调 Qwen3.5-27B 将 Terminal-Bench 2.1 改进为Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-27B on the resulting corpus improves Terminal-Bench 2.1 by11.911.9点和 EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4 通过points and EvoCode-Bench v2 MT@4 by13.813.8指向相同的基本模型。消融证实了每个组件都有贡献，值得注意的是，在重建环境中进行解析远远优于模仿原始轨迹。points over the same base model. Ablations confirm that each component contributes, and notably that re-solving in reconstructed environments far outperforms imitating the raw trajectories.

2 相关工作Related Work

终端代理的环境扩展。Environment scaling for terminal agents.现有方法通过三种主要途径扩展可执行工作空间：从真实的开发历史恢复存储库状态、修改功能工作空间或从生成的规范构建特定于任务的环境。 SWE-健身房Existing methods scale executable workspaces through three main routes: recovering repository states from real development histories, modifying functioning workspaces, or constructing task-specific environments from generated specifications. SWE-Gym(Pan et al., 2024)和R2E-健身房and R2E-Gym(Jain et al., 2025)从与历史问题或提交相关的存储库版本构建环境。瑞典史密斯construct environments from repository versions associated with historical issues or commits. SWE-smith(Yang et al., 2025)和 CLI-Gymand CLI-Gym(Lin et al., 2026)从工作存储库或 CLI 工作区开始，并向其中引入错误或故障。塞塔start from working repositories or CLI workspaces and introduce bugs or failures into them. SETA(Shen et al., 2026b)相反，通过综合和自适应环境进化来扩展可验证的终端环境以进行强化学习。一个单独的族共同生成终端任务及其容器化执行环境；我们在下面讨论他们的任务构建策略。相反，终端宇宙以记录的特工轨迹作为起点。它重播每个轨迹中记录的文件操作，并使用代理完成来恢复丢失的项目上下文，生成可重用的可执行工作区。instead scales verifiable terminal environments for reinforcement learning through synthesis and adaptive environment evolution. A separate family jointly generates terminal tasks and their containerized execution environments; we discuss their task-construction strategies below. Terminal-Universe instead takes recorded agent trajectories as its starting point. It replays the file operations recorded in each trajectory and uses agentic completion to restore missing project context, producing executable workspaces that can be reused.

终端任务合成。Terminal task synthesis.现有方法从抽象先验或具体可执行环境中派生任务。自上而下的管道从类别或种子生成任务环境对Existing methods derive tasks either from abstract priors or concrete executable environments. Top-down pipelines generate task-environment pairs from categories or seeds(Gandhi et al., 2026; Pi et al., 2026; Zhu et al., 2026)，而更结构化的变体则围绕能力分类、组合轴或技能图组织生成, while more structured variants organize generation around capability taxonomies, compositional axes, or skill graphs(Hua et al., 2026; Ivison et al., 2026; Fan et al., 2026)。其他方法使用代理技能、可执行元任务或求解器反馈来多样化和校准生成的任务. Other methods use agent skills, executable meta-tasks, or solver feedback to diversify and calibrate the generated tasks(Cheng et al., 2026; Pan et al., 2026; Meng et al., 2026).

相反，基于环境的方法从工作代码和项目上下文中派生任务。他们扰乱健康的环境，挖掘存储库文档，实际问题中的地面任务，或者在共享环境中共同实现指令、解决方案和验证器Environment-grounded methods instead derive tasks from working code and project context. They perturb healthy environments, mine repository documentation, ground tasks in real issues, or jointly realize instructions, solutions, and verifiers in a shared environment(Lin et al., 2026; Wu et al., 2026a; Yang et al., 2026; Shi et al., 2026)。 RST 通过延长解决方案并重新调整其任务、验证者和环境来递归地扩展已验证的种子. RST recursively expands verified seeds by lengthening solutions and realigning their tasks, verifiers, and environments(Li et al., 2026b)。 Terminal-Universe 以过去的智能体轨迹为起点：它会重建其工作空间，然后在其内部或之间生成新任务。. Terminal-Universe takes past agent trajectories as its starting point: it reconstructs their workspaces before generating new tasks within or across them.

交互式和多轮代理。Interactive and multi-round agents.最近的基准测试超越了孤立的单轮提示，将代理交互建模为动态的多轮对话。 InterCode 通过容器化 shell 中的执行反馈来形式化交互式编码Moving beyond isolated, single-turn prompts, recent benchmarks model agent interaction as dynamic, multi-turn dialogues. InterCode formalizes interactive coding via execution feedback in containerized shells(Yang et al., 2023)。 SWE互动. SWE-INTERACT(Raghavendra et al., 2026)使用模拟用户逐步揭示需求并提供有针对性的修订，而 SWE-Togetheruses a simulated user to progressively reveal requirements and provide targeted revisions, while SWE-Together(Wu et al., 2026b)通过状态条件用户模拟器重播真实的用户代理会话，该模拟器在评估代理的进展时提供反馈。 ICAE-工作台replays real user–agent sessions through a state-conditional user simulator that provides feedback as an evaluated agent progresses. ICAE-Bench(Peng et al., 2026b)使用自动化用户代理根据不完整的产品需求评估交互式项目构建。在持久工作区中，EvoCode-Bench v2evaluates interactive project construction from incomplete product requirements using an automated user agent. In persistent workspaces, EvoCode-Bench v2(Shen et al., 2026a)跨顺序开发请求评估代理。 Terminal-Universe 通过深度扩展来拥抱这种交互式设置，将重建的工作空间扩展到多轮会话中，以捕获迭代的用户反馈和需求细化。evaluates agents across sequential development requests. Terminal-Universe embraces this interactive setting through depth expansion, extending reconstructed workspaces into multi-round sessions that capture iterative user feedback and requirement refinement.

Table 1终端宇宙与代表性方法相对立。与之前的工作相比，它根据记录的轨迹构建环境，并沿着广度（跨工作空间综合）和深度（多轮查询）扩展任务。positions Terminal-Universe against representative methods. In contrast to prior work, it builds its environments from recorded trajectories and scales tasks along both breadth (cross-workspace synthesis) and depth (multi-round queries).

3 终端宇宙Terminal-Universe

Figure 2详细介绍了环境重建、四种重新查询变体和验证的机制。以下小节描述了环境重建（details the mechanisms across environment reconstruction, the four re-querying variants, and verification. 3.1 环境重建Environment Reconstruction

从文件和命令中记录操作轨迹From the file and command operations recorded in a trajectoryτ\tau，我们恢复一个可执行工作空间, we recover an executable workspaceE^\widehat{E}近似环境that approximates the environmentEE其中in whichτ\tau被生产出来了。这种恢复本质上是有损的，因为未访问的文件、隐式系统依赖性和外部网络资源不会留下直接痕迹。因此，我们分三个阶段进行重建： 确定性重放恢复文件状态was produced. This recovery is inherently lossy, since unaccessed files, implicit system dependencies, and external network resources leave no direct trace. We therefore reconstruct in three stages: deterministic replay recovers the file statesτ\tau直接公开，代理完成提供其省略的潜在上下文，环境过滤仅保留足以恢复任务的工作空间exposes directly, agentic completion supplies the latent context it omits, and environment filtering keeps only workspaces sufficient for the recovered taskqq.

3.2 重新查询Re-querying

虽然重建产生了可执行环境，但重新查询决定了如何有效地利用其潜在能力空间。我们引入了四种互补的重新查询机制，在本文中分别表示为 Intent Recovery、Single-WS、Cross-WS 和 Multi-Round。 Intent Recovery 重建源任务，而 Single-WS 在各个工作区中综合新任务。 Cross-WS 通过连接相关工作空间来提供广度，而 Multi-Round 通过将初始查询扩展到交互式会话来提供深度。While reconstruction yields executable environments, re-querying dictates how effectively their latent capability space is exploited. We introduce four complementary re-querying mechanisms, denoted throughout the paper as Intent Recovery, Single-WS, Cross-WS, and Multi-Round. Intent Recovery reconstructs source tasks, while Single-WS synthesizes new tasks within individual workspaces. Cross-WS provides breadth by connecting related workspaces, and Multi-Round provides depth by extending an initial query into an interactive session.

我们将每个源轨迹标准化为用户请求、代理操作和文件更改的时间顺序流。对于单轮轨迹，唯一的实质性用户请求直接定义任务。对于多轮轨迹，第一个实质性用户请求建立任务主题，而后续请求在澄清、约束或扩展同一任务时被合并；不相关的任务转移被排除在外。我们使用代理操作并提交证据来解释请求，但仅保留用户提出的要求（We normalize each source trajectory into a chronological stream of user requests, agent actions, and file changes. For a single-round trajectory, the sole substantive user request directly defines the task. For a multi-round trajectory, the first substantive user request establishes the task topic, while later requests are incorporated when they clarify, constrain, or extend the same task; unrelated task shifts are excluded. We use agent actions and file evidence to interpret the requests, but retain only requirements stated by the user (§ C.1).

离线生成器检查每个工作空间，并在基础性、结构多样性和可验证性约束下综合五个独立的候选任务。我们为每个环境随机选择一名有效候选者进行部署和验证。An offline generator inspects each workspace and synthesizes five self-contained candidate tasks under groundedness, structural diversity, and verifiability constraints. We randomly select one valid candidate per environment for rollout and verification.

跨工作空间综合。Cross-workspace synthesis.为了综合跨多个代码库的任务，我们发现了恢复环境中的方向依赖关系。代理首先介绍每个工作空间的技术领域和实施的功能。然后，我们通过 TF-IDF 最近邻搜索检索候选对，并使用 LLM 判断来识别目标工作空间缺乏参考工作空间中已实现的功能的方向依赖边缘。To synthesize tasks spanning multiple codebases, we discover directional dependency relationships across recovered environments. An agent first profiles each workspace’s technical domain and implemented capabilities. We then retrieve candidate pairs via TF-IDF nearest-neighbor search, and employ an LLM judge to identify directional dependency edges where a target workspace lacks a capability already implemented in a reference workspace.

我们为每对分配一个任务。每个跨工作空间任务将可写目标工作空间与安装在单独路径上的只读参考工作空间配对。任务生成器确认功能差距是真实的，并指定目标中弥合此差距的可观察行为，可通过确定性本地命令进行验证。查询仅提供这些目标行为和引用的安装路径，而不提供其内部详细信息，从而使引用保持真正的依赖关系。因此，求解器必须自行导航、内化和调整参考实现。We allocate exactly one task per pair. Each cross-workspace task pairs a writable target workspace with a read-only reference workspace mounted at a separate path. The task generator confirms that the functional gap is genuine and specifies observable behaviors in the target that bridge this gap, verifiable via deterministic local commands. The query provides only these target behaviors and the reference’s mount path, not its internal details, keeping the reference a genuine dependency. The solver must therefore navigate, internalize, and adapt the reference implementation on its own.

多轮用户查询。Multi-round user queries.从初始终端查询开始，我们在编码轮次中保留工作空间，并在初始响应后引入用户代理。延续过程采用两种协调机制来确保连贯且现实的多转弯轨迹：Beginning with an initial terminal query, we preserve the workspace across coding rounds and introduce a user agent after the initial response. The continuation process employs two coordinated mechanisms to ensure coherent and realistic multi-turn trajectories:

  1. 1.

    不断发展的任务规范。Evolving task specification.用户代理维护一个明确的需求跟踪器，记录活动的、满足的和更新的需求。在每次后续行动之前，它都会通过添加、修改或替换约束来更新此跟踪器，从而随着工作空间的发展保持上下文连贯性。The user agent maintains an explicit requirement tracker logging active, satisfied, and updated requirements. Prior to each follow-up, it updates this tracker by adding, modifying, or replacing constraints, maintaining contextual coherence as the workspace evolves.

  2. 2.

    轮次验证和反馈。Round-level verification and feedback.在每个扩展回合中，用户代理都会提交更新的规范，提示自动验证者在编码代理执行操作之前编写回合级验收测试。收到代理的响应后，测试运行者会评估新标准和主动回归检查。求解器代理与测试脚本和回溯严格隔离；用户代理解释结构化测试结果，并将任何失败转化为自然的、用户可观察到的投诉。中间故障保留在对话历史记录中，为错误诊断和恢复提供现实的监督。At each extension round, the user agent commits the updated specification, prompting an automated verifier to author round-level acceptance tests before the coding agent acts. Upon receiving the agent’s response, the test runner evaluates both new criteria and active regression checks. The solver agent is strictly isolated from test scripts and tracebacks; the user agent interprets the structured test results and translates any failure into natural, user-observable complaints. Intermediate failures are retained within the conversation history, providing realistic supervision for error diagnosis and recovery.

在各轮中，用户代理的请求分为三种交互风格：（i）功能扩展，在成功验证后引入新的基础要求； (ii) 功能修订，由测试失败触发，要求根据观察到的行为修复错误； (iii) 功能冲突，它修改或覆盖先前的规范以反映不断变化的用户意图。每个请求的风格自然地遵循回合结果和会话上下文，并且结果分布被报告为观察到的（Across rounds, the user agent’s requests fall into three interaction styles: (i) feature extension, which introduces new grounded requirements following successful verification; (ii) feature revision, triggered by test failures to demand bug fixes based on observed behavior; and (iii) feature conflict, which modifies or overrides prior specifications to reflect changing user intent. The style of each request follows naturally from the round outcome and the session context, and the resulting distribution is reported as observed (§ E.3, Table 17）。会话最多持续六轮后续回合，或者直到发出终止哨兵。). Sessions continue for up to six follow-up rounds or until a termination sentinel is emitted.

3.3 验证和过滤Verification and Filtering

代理验证器构建。Agentic verifier construction.每个单 WS 或跨 WS 任务都与由目标容器内的专用代理编写的可执行验证程序配对。以任务规范和工作空间文件为条件，验证者代理通过迭代本地执行制作一个独立的 pytest 套件，严格评估提示中指定的公共接口和预期行为（Each Single-WS or Cross-WS task is paired with an executable verifier authored by a dedicated agent within the target container. Conditioning on the task specification and workspace files, the verifier agent crafts a self-contained pytest suite through iterative local execution, strictly evaluating the public interfaces and expected behaviors specified in the prompt (Appendix D).

解决方案推出。Solution rollout.使用教师模型推出候选解决方案Candidate solutions are rolled out using the teacher model11 1本工作中的所有模型驱动组件均使用 Qwen3.7-Max（xhigheffort）作为教师模型。All model-driven components in this work use Qwen3.7-Max (xhigh effort) as the teacher model.在克劳德代码脚手架中within the Claude Code scaffold(Anthropic, 2026)在任务容器内。推出随温度解码inside the task container. Rollouts decode with temperature1.01.0, 顶-, top-p=0.95p=0.95，并交错思考, and interleaved thinking over a256256k 令牌上下文窗口，回合响应上限为k-token context window, with turn responses capped at65,53665{,}536令牌，主动汇总触发于tokens, proactive summarization triggered at176176k 个令牌，最多为k tokens, and a maximum of500500代理在四小时的挂钟超时下轮流。任务环境提供容器化网络访问来获取缺少的依赖项（agent turns under a four-hour wall-clock timeout. The task environment provides containerized network access to fetch absent dependencies (§ 3.1).

验证和数据选择。Verification and data selection.对于单 WS 和跨 WS，编写的测试套件在推出后针对最终工作区状态运行，并且仅当所有测试都通过时才接受轨迹。相反，多轮是在轮级别选择的：我们从终止的会话中删除连续失败轮的尾随后缀，并仅在会话包含至少两个经过验证的通过轮时才保留会话。成功恢复之前的中间故障将被保留，为错误诊断和恢复提供监督。接受的轨迹被格式化为多圈 SFT 演示，并根据评估基准进行严格的净化（For Single-WS and Cross-WS, the authored test suite runs against the final workspace state after rollout, and a trajectory is accepted only if all tests pass. Multi-Round is selected at the round level instead: we trim trailing suffixes of consecutive failed rounds from terminated sessions and retain a session only if it contains at least two verified passing rounds. Intermediate failures that precede a successful recovery are kept, supplying supervision for error diagnosis and recovery. Accepted trajectories are formatted into multi-turn SFT demonstrations and undergo strict decontamination against evaluation benchmarks (§ 5).

Each task is evaluated in four independent runs. MT@4 uses fail-stop scoring: a run receives credit only for the consecutive rounds it passes before its first failure, and each task-round is credited if any run reaches it successfully. The score averages credited rounds within each task and then across tasks. Case score averages verifier-case pass rates within tasks and then across tasks and runs to measure partial progress.

7 讨论和限制Discussion and Limitations

通过更丰富的源轨迹进行扩展。Scaling with richer source trajectories.虽然终端宇宙在应用于公共轨迹语料库时表现出强大的有效性，但我们对高质量轨迹的经验观察揭示了源轨迹的复杂性与在重建环境上合成的结果推出的复杂性之间存在正相关性。具有更丰富的操作动态的轨迹，例如多文件操作和长工具使用链，暴露了更广泛的工作空间状态，这反过来又支持更多样化和更苛刻的综合任务。聚合也可能会提高环境复杂性：当多个会话在同一工作空间上运行时，将它们一起重播会将每个会话公开的状态合并到单个重建中，从而产生比任何单个轨迹可以恢复的环境更复杂的环境。总之，这些观察结果表明，随着智能体能力的进步，复杂的轨迹变得越来越容易获得，框架会自然地扩展。While Terminal-Universe demonstrates strong effectiveness when applied to public trajectory corpora, our empirical observations on higher-quality trajectories reveal a positive correlation between the complexity of the source trajectories and that of the resulting rollouts synthesized on the reconstructed environments. Trajectories with richer operational dynamics, such as multi-file manipulations and long tool-use chains, expose broader workspace state, which in turn supports more diverse and more demanding synthesized tasks. Environment complexity can also be raised by aggregation: when multiple sessions operate on the same workspace, replaying them together merges the state exposed by each session into a single reconstruction, producing environments more complex than any single trajectory can recover. Together, these observations suggest that the framework scales naturally as advancing agent capabilities make complex trajectories increasingly easy to obtain.

局限性。Limitations.终端宇宙也有一些限制。首先，我们对所有工作区使用标准 Ubuntu 24.04 容器，而不是通过 SWE-Factory 等自动化管道构建定制的、特定于存储库的环境Terminal-Universe also has several limitations. First, we use standard Ubuntu 24.04 containers for all workspaces rather than building tailored, repository-specific environments via automated pipelines like SWE-Factory(Guo et al., 2026)或 RepoLaunchor RepoLaunch(Li et al., 2026a)。因此，需要专门的系统依赖性或复杂的编译步骤的边缘情况可能会表现出保真度降低。其次，我们重建的工作空间的领域、语言和工具链分布从根本上受到所收集的源轨迹的覆盖范围的限制。超越这些发行版仍然是未来工作的重要途径。第三，单个教师生成任务、解决方案和验证器。因此，它的能力差距可能会限制任务覆盖范围，而它在解决方案中犯的错误也可能会被测试遗漏。未来的工作可以使用多个教师和一个独立的模型来构建验证者。. As a result, edge cases requiring specialized system dependencies or complex compilation steps may exhibit reduced fidelity. Second, the domain, language, and toolchain distributions of our reconstructed workspaces are fundamentally bounded by the coverage of the collected source trajectories. Expanding beyond these distributions remains an important avenue for future work. Third, a single teacher generates tasks, solutions, and verifiers. Its capability gaps may therefore limit task coverage, while errors it makes in solutions may also be missed by its tests. Future work could use multiple teachers and an independent model for verifier construction.

8 结论Conclusion

在这项工作中，我们提出了 Terminal-Universe，一个基于轨迹的环境和任务合成框架，它将记录的代理轨迹从固定演示重新构建为可恢复、可重用的执行环境。通过确定性重放和代理完成的两个阶段过程，终端宇宙恢复潜在的工作空间状态，在每个环境中综合新任务，并将其扩展到工作空间的广度和跨轮的深度。实证评估表明，在源轨迹上，解决恢复任务的性能优于 SFT，而验证者选择的单 WS、跨 WS 和多轮轨迹提高了单轮和多轮终端代理的性能。总的来说，我们的研究结果表明，记录的轨迹可以有效地重新用于交互式执行环境，为合成接地代理训练数据提供可扩展的范例，而无需从头开始构建环境。In this work, we present Terminal-Universe, a trajectory-based environment and task synthesis framework that reframes recorded agent trajectories from fixed demonstrations into recoverable, reusable execution environments. Through a two-stage process of deterministic replay and agentic completion, Terminal-Universe restores latent workspace state, synthesizes new tasks within each environment, and expands them across workspaces for breadth and across rounds for depth. Empirical evaluations show that re-solving recovered tasks outperforms SFT on the source trajectories, while verifier-selected Single-WS, Cross-WS, and Multi-Round trajectories improve both single- and multi-round terminal-agent performance. Overall, our findings demonstrate that recorded trajectories can be effectively repurposed into interactive execution environments, offering a scalable paradigm for synthesizing grounded agent training data without constructing environments from scratch.

B.1 重建及竣工Reconstruction and Completion

源语料库以不同的方式编码文件操作，因此我们将读取、写入和编辑规范化为有序事件流。我们保留只读文件的观察内容，对于修改的文件，保留第一次更改之前可见的内容。这些内容可能是部分的或被截断的。代理创建的文件以及所有后续更改都将保留在重播工作区之外。Source corpora encode file operations differently, so we normalize reads, writes, and edits into an ordered event stream. We keep the observed content of read-only files and, for modified files, the content visible before the first change. These contents may be partial or truncated. Files created by the agent and all later changes are left out of the replayed workspace.

完成代理接收恢复的请求、部分工作空间和文件清单。它通过创建文件、完成部分文件以及配置现有项目所需的依赖项来填充缺失的项目上下文。它不得执行所请求的任务或揭示应在何处提出解决方案。The completion agent receives the recovered request, partial workspace, and file inventory. It fills missing project context by creating files, completing partial files, and configuring dependencies needed by the existing project. It must not implement the requested task or reveal where its solution should be made.

包装。Packaging.重建项目划归Reconstructed projects are placed under/应用程序/app。文件系统中其他地方访问的文件是单独存储的。. Files accessed elsewhere in the filesystem are stored separately.

竣工质量。Completion quality.对 30 个随机抽样的终端完成情况进行手动检查发现，22 个仅包含与任务相关的支持文件，而 8 个引入了支持任务不需要的大量文件或代码。我们在 30 个已完成的工作空间中没有找到任务解决方案。Manual inspection of 30 randomly sampled Terminal completions found that 22 contained only task-relevant support files, while eight introduced substantial files or code not needed to support the task. We found no task solutions in the 30 completed workspaces.

B.2 工作空间充足性评估Workspace Sufficiency Evaluation

评价范围。Evaluation scope.我们评估经过去污和存储库级重复数据删除后幸存下来的每一次终端重建。对于 SWE，我们评估了一个代表性重建及其每个存储库的意图恢复任务。代理法官使用只读 shell 和文件工具检查每个工作区。We evaluate every terminal reconstruction that survives decontamination and repository-level deduplication. For SWE, we evaluate one representative reconstruction and its Intent Recovery task per repository. The agentic judge inspects each workspace with read-only shell and file tools.

得分。Scoring.当工作空间的源、配置、数据和结构为有能力的代理提供足够的上下文来处理任务时，该工作空间就是任务充足的。不需要依赖项、缓存、生成的输出以及可以重新创建的可选文档。法官评估的是可用的项目背景，而不是是否取得成功。A workspace is task-sufficient when its source, configuration, data, and structure give a capable agent enough context to work on the task. Dependencies, caches, generated outputs, and optional documentation that can be recreated are not required. The judge evaluates available project context rather than build success.

Table 14给出了相应的源级别细分。gives the corresponding source-level breakdowns.

充足率反映了轨迹暴露了多少项目背景。代理完成可以围绕观察到的证据添加常见的项目文件，但无法恢复未见的项目特定内容。一些 SWE 子集太小，无法进行细粒度比较。Sufficiency rates reflect how much project context the trajectories expose. Agentic completion can add common project files around observed evidence but cannot recover unseen project-specific content. Some SWE subsets are too small for fine-grained comparison.

B.3 故障分析Failure Analysis

对于任务不足的工作空间，法官会引用丢失或截断的源文件、任务脚本、 输入数据、配置和部署文件。缺少测试、清单或包初始化 文件通常表示部分源代码树。For task-insufficient workspaces, the judge cites missing or truncated source files, task scripts, input data, configuration, and deployment files. Missing tests, manifests, or package init files usually indicate a partial source tree.

附录CAppendix C重新查询明细Re-querying Details

在所有四种变体中，生成的请求指定一个可观察的目标，同时将实施策略留给编码代理。Across all four variants, the generated request specifies an observable goal while leaving the implementation strategy to the coding agent.

跨工作空间布局。Cross-workspace layout.每个 Cross-WS 对安装为Each Cross-WS pair is mounted as仓库0repo0和and回购1repo1下under/应用程序/工作区/app/workspaces。生成代理选择一个可写目标和一个只读引用。编码代理看到相同的布局，验证者检查引用是否保持不变（. The generation agent chooses a writable target and a read-only reference. The coding agent sees the same layout, and the verifier checks that the reference remains unchanged (§ 3.3).

及时演示。Prompt presentation.模板保留每个生成器的输入、指令和输出模式。重复 规则和示例被缩短。尖括号中的值在运行时填充。The templates retain each generator’s inputs, instructions, and output schema. Repeated rules and examples are shortened. Values in angle brackets are filled at runtime.

C.1 意图恢复Intent Recovery

生成机制。Generation mechanism.意图恢复接收已清理的任务、按时间顺序排列的对话跟踪和文件 证据。单轮轨迹直接使用其唯一的实质性用户请求。对于 多轮轨迹，第一个实质性请求设定任务主题；稍后的请求 仅当它们澄清、限制或扩展同一任务且不相关时才被合并 任务转移被排除在外。我们使用代理行动并提交证据来解释请求， 但仅保留用户提出的要求。仅生成的Intent Recovery receives the cleaned task, a chronological conversation trace, and file evidence. A single-round trajectory uses its sole substantive user request directly. For a multi-round trajectory, the first substantive request sets the task topic; later requests are incorporated only when they clarify, constrain, or extend the same task, and unrelated task shifts are excluded. We use agent actions and file evidence to interpret the requests, but retain only requirements stated by the user. Only the generated核心目标core_objective成为意图 恢复指导；其余输出字段保留为元数据。becomes the Intent Recovery instruction; the remaining output fields are retained as metadata.

C.2 单WS合成Single-WS Synthesis

生成机制。Generation mechanism.Single-WS 接收路径清单并可以以只读方式检查选定的文件 命令。它无法修改存储库、访问网络或扫描外部 工作区。在解析和重复数据删除之后，我们为每个工作区选择一项基础任务。Single-WS receives a path inventory and may inspect selected files with read-only commands. It cannot modify the repository, access the network, or scan outside the workspace. After parsing and deduplication, we select one grounded task per workspace.

C.3 跨WS综合Cross-WS Synthesis

候选人采购。Candidate sourcing.我们分析每个工作区，然后使用 TF-IDF 检索每个工作区中附近的候选者 语言组。法学硕士将每一对标记为相似、互补、依赖或 不相关并确定缺少能力的一方。然后我们选择依赖 使用文件检查进行配对，没有工作空间出现在两对中的规则，以及如何进行限制 通常每个工作区都会被使用。两个存储库都是 作为对等体安装，生成代理选择他们的最终角色。We profile each workspace, then use TF–IDF to retrieve nearby candidates within each language group. An LLM labels each pair as similar, complementary, dependency, or unrelated and identifies the side with the missing capability. We then select dependency pairs using file checks, a rule that no workspace appears in two pairs, and a limit on how often each workspace is used. Both repositories are mounted as peers, and the generation agent chooses their final roles.

任务生成。Task generation.生成代理读取两个存储库，分配它们的角色，并返回一个任务， 提交证据，以及三个隐藏的依赖事实。该任务必须至少依赖于三个 仅在参考文献中找到的详细信息，但无法说明这些详细信息或命名其内部 路径。它必须命名目标文件，定义可执行检查，保留现有目标 行为，保持参考不变，并保持可离线求解。配对无 有用的参考资产被拒绝。A generation agent reads both repositories, assigns their roles, and returns one task, file evidence, and three hidden dependency facts. The task must depend on at least three details found only in the reference, but cannot state those details or name its internal paths. It must name the target files, define executable checks, preserve existing target behavior, leave the reference unchanged, and remain solvable offline. Pairs without a useful reference asset are rejected.

检查。Checks.我们拒绝格式错误、陈述隐藏事实或名称为内部的任务 参考路径。 SFT 记录需要有效的查询、验证器和成功的教师轨迹。We reject tasks that are malformed, that state the hidden facts, or that name internal reference paths. SFT records require a valid query, verifier, and successful teacher trajectory.

C.4 多轮用户查询Multi-Round User Queries

生成机制。Generation mechanism.多轮通过私下读取请求的用户代理继续解决会话， 对话、工作空间、活动需求和最新验证者结果。只有下一个 用户消息显示给编码代理。失败后，要求纠正 不改变要求；通过后，它可能会添加兼容的扩展或 允许更换。每次响应后都会测试新的和活跃的需求，但是 保持私密。一个会话最多有六轮后续轮次。Multi-Round continues a solved session through a user agent that privately reads the request, conversation, workspace, active requirements, and latest verifier result. Only its next user message is shown to the coding agent. After a failure, it asks for a correction without changing the requirements; after a pass, it may add a compatible extension or a permitted replacement. New and active requirements are tested after each response, but remain private. A session has at most six follow-up rounds.

训练轨迹过滤。Training-trajectory filtering.对于 SFT，我们删除了尾随验证者失败的回合。我们与以下人士保持会议 至少经过两轮。失败的回合仍保留 反馈和纠正。For SFT, we remove trailing verifier-failed rounds. We keep sessions with at least two passing rounds. Failed rounds remain with feedback and correction.

附录DAppendix D验证器构造细节Verifier Construction Details

测试规则。Test rules.对于单 WS 和跨 WS 任务，验证代理会看到任务规范和初始工作区，但看不到解决方案。它使用绝对路径和公共接口编写一个独立的 pytest 文件。测试必须在没有网络访问且不修改工作空间的情况下执行任务要求；临时文件放置在For Single-WS and Cross-WS tasks, the verification agent sees the task specification and the initial workspace, but not the solution. It writes one self-contained pytest file using absolute paths and public interfaces. The tests must exercise the task requirements without network access and without modifying the workspace; temporary files are placed under/tmp.

意图恢复。Intent Recovery.意图恢复不被代理验证器过滤，保留了与源轨迹 SFT 的可比性。Intent Recovery is not filtered by an agentic verifier, preserving comparability with source-trajectory SFT.

E.1 重建和单工作空间重新查询Reconstruction and Single-Workspace Re-querying

我们通过 TypeScript 和 React 项目 (MirrorBrain) 来说明重构和重用。 其工作区支持多种编码任务，无需丢失源文件。We illustrate reconstruction and reuse with a TypeScript and React project (MirrorBrain). E.2 跨WS综合Cross-WS Synthesis

我们在两个用于 RSA 加密的 C 工具包上跟踪跨 WS 综合。目标提供密钥生成， 加密、签名但无解密程序；该参考实现了完整的 往返。因此，关系匹配选择 RSA 解密作为缺失的功能。We trace Cross-WS synthesis on two C toolkits for RSA cryptography. 根深蒂固的能力差距。Grounded capability gap.目标具有密钥生成、加密和签名，但没有解密源。其 加密器修复了填充模式和公钥加载器，而明文是 往返输入。该参考揭示了私钥加载器，解密 调用、填充模式和硬编码输入路径。这些隐藏的事实并没有出现在 任务，仅命名引用根。The target has key generation, encryption, and signing but no decryption source. Its encryptor fixes the padding mode and public-key loader, while the plaintext is the round-trip input. The reference reveals the private-key loader, decrypt call, padding mode, and hardcoded input paths. These hidden facts do not appear in the task, which names only the reference root.

Preservation tests cover the existing programs and keep the reference unchanged. The teacher solution passes the full suite.

E.3 多轮用户查询Multi-Round User Queries

Table 18跨轮跟踪用户请求。follows the user requests across rounds.

故障驱动的功能修订。Failure-driven feature revision.第一个延续添加了持久增量聚合，但未播种随机 缩放使其值不稳定。私人验证者发现了这个失败。用户代理保留 相同的要求并要求更正而不暴露测试：The first continuation adds persistent incremental aggregation, but unseeded random scaling makes its values unstable. The private verifier catches this failure. The user agent keeps the same requirements and asks for a correction without exposing the tests:

代理删除随机缩放并通过下一个检查，之后用户代理请求 基于阈值的警报。测试代码和结果永远不会进入求解器可见的对话中。The agent removes the random scaling and passes the next check, after which the user agent requests threshold-based alerting. Test code and results never enter the solver-visible conversation.

受控的需求冲突。Controlled requirement conflict.警报通过后，用户代理将每次运行的 JSON 列表替换为持久事件 历史记录，将此视为新产品决策而不是缺陷：After alerting passes, the user agent replaces the per-run JSON list with a durable event history, stating this as a new product decision rather than a defect:

修订后的历史记录要求适用于其余几轮，其中增加了报告、 和解、修复。The revised history requirement governs the remaining rounds, which add reporting, reconciliation, and repair.
